StakeBaseUpgradeable mapping(uint256 => uint256) of the block.timestamp when a tokenId was staked.

StakeBaseUpgradeable mapping(uint256 => address) of tokenId to current staker.
StakeBaseUpgradeable mapping(address => bool) used for unique staker counting.

IERC721Like reference to the staked NFT contract, target of external calls.
Oil token contract reference used by the staking system.
Address where staked NFTs are custodied; if zero it defaults to address(this).
Oil mapping(address => uint256) of token balances, mutated by transfers, swaps and rescues.
Oil reentrancy guard status storage used by the nonReentrant modifier.
Oil boolean flag set by lockTheSwap to guard the token->ETH swap path.
BibizStakeUpgradeable.initialize: initializer wiring staking/token/oil addresses and defaulting stakingContract to address(this).
View returning tokensOfOwner[owner_] for an arbitrary address, exposing full staking positions.
View returning the staked owner of a tokenId from tokenOwner.
Batch view returning stake timestamps for an unbounded array of tokenIds.
Batch view computing block.timestamp - tokenStakedTime[tokenId], a timestamp-dependent value.
IERC721Receiver hook always returning the selector; the callback entry point during safe transfers.
__StakeBaseUpgradeable_init: grants ADMIN/MANAGER/UPGRADER roles to msg.sender and sets contract addresses.
External unstake of selected tokenIds: per-token ownership check, external transfers, then array cleanup and unique owner recount.
External unstake of all tokens of msg.sender, then delete of the stored array.
External stake of tokenIds requiring isApprovedForAll and per-token ownerOf checks.
Private _stake: safeTransferFrom into the staking contract, pushes tokenId and records tokenStakedTime.
Private _unstake: safeTransferFrom from the staking contract back to msg.sender then deletes tokenOwner.
Private bookkeeping that increments/decrements uniqueOwnerCount based on stakers[msg.sender].
UUPS authorization hook restricted to UPGRADER_ROLE.
UUPS upgradeTo entrypoint guarded by onlyProxy and _authorizeUpgrade.
UUPS upgradeToAndCall: upgrades implementation and delegatecalls arbitrary data if data.length > 0.
Oil.transfer: blocklist check and _transfer with fee-on-transfer logic.
Oil.transferFrom: allowance decrement and _transfer, no reentrancy guard on the swap path.
Oil._transfer: applies sell tax, calls swapTokensForEth BEFORE decrementing balanceOf[from].
Oil.swapTokensForEth: approves the router and executes swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp deadline.
Oil._mint: increases totalSupply and uses unchecked balanceOf[to] += value.
Oil._burn: decreases balanceOf[from] and uses unchecked totalSupply -= value.
Oil.swapRoyals: mutual royal swap path manipulating balances, escrowedOil, royalSwaps and ownerOfRoyal.
Oil.cancelSwap: refunds escrowedOil[myRoyalId_] to the caller and deletes the pending swap.
Oil.rescue: onlyRuler emergency migration of staked ids to another staker address.
Oil.freeze: callable only by the royals contract, burns habibiz stake entries for a royal id.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, role grants, balance indexing and role modifiers.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for staking timestamps, elapsed-time math and swap deadlines.
External call tokenContract.safeTransferFrom, which invokes onERC721Received on contract recipients.
External calls tokenContract.ownerOf / isApprovedForAll on the untrusted NFT contract.
Low-level delegatecall in ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._functionDelegateCall with caller-supplied data.
uniqueOwnerCount++ / -- arithmetic that can desynchronize the counter from real staker state.
External router call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens invoked mid-transfer.
Unchecked balanceOf[to] += value inside Oil._mint.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= cost and escrowedOil bookkeeping inside swapRoyals.
Unchecked totalSupply -= value inside Oil._burn.
tokenIds_ calldata parameter of stake/unstake, fully attacker-controlled length and contents.
Loop counter i used in unstake, stake and batch view functions.
Inner loop counter j used in the nested cleanup loop of unstake.
stakingContract_ address parameter of initialize.
Local variable defaulting stakingContract_ to address(this) when zero.
Memory copy of tokensOfOwner[msg.sender] used by unstakeAll.
Return array built in stakedTimeOf.
Return array built in secondsStakedOf from timestamp differences.
Locally computed swap cost in swapRoyals derived from swapRoyalsCost.
Accumulator of OIL rewards in Oil._unstake/_unstakeByIds/freeze.

normalization_plan.reason: The external tokenIds_ array only exists to drive the unstake loop and its per-token ownership checks, so it collapses into the unstake function node.
Loop index i has no standalone semantic meaning outside the unstake iteration logic.
Inner loop index j only exists for the nested tokensOfOwner cleanup inside unstake.
The stakingContract_ argument is only consumed by the initializer to seed storage.
The cached _stakingContract value is only forwarded into __StakeBaseUpgradeable_init.
The memory copy of the staker's token list is used solely by the unstakeAll loop.
The array is a purely transient return buffer of the stakedTimeOf view.
The array is a purely transient return buffer of the secondsStakedOf view.
The cost local is derived from swapRoyalsCost only to gate the swapRoyals balance check.
The oil accumulator only carries reward amounts within the freeze execution.
